chunks: When it is said to them: 'Bow before Ar-Rahman,' they say: 'What is Ar-Rahman? Should we bow to whoever you ask us to?' And their aversion increases further.
ai.seo_question: Why did the disbelievers ask 'What is Ar-Rahman?' when commanded to prostrate?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the cognitive dissonance of the disbelievers, who reject the attribute of 'Ar-Rahman' not due to lack of knowledge, but due to spiritual arrogance and a desire for autonomy. Their sarcastic query, 'What is Ar-Rahman?', signifies a deeper rejection of divine mercy as a basis for worship, leading to an increase in their aversion (nufur) as a consequence of their stubbornness.
